taxonomy.name: AI and software
taxonomy.definition: Builds software, and builds AI products on top of models. Most of these jobs are remote or in an office, and most pay well above the county median.

subs.name: AI engineering
subs.definition: Builds products on top of models: agents, retrieval, evaluation and prompt pipelines.

subs.name: Platform and infrastructure
subs.definition: Keeps services and model serving running: cloud, containers, reliability, GPU fleets.

subs.name: Product software
subs.definition: Writes the product itself across the stack: general software engineering roles.

subs.name: Frontend and mobile
subs.definition: Builds the interface the user touches: web frontend, iOS, Android and design systems.

subs.name: Backend and APIs
subs.definition: Builds the server side: backend endpoints, APIs and service integrations.

subs.name: Data engineering
subs.definition: Moves and models data: pipelines, warehouses and analytics engineering.

subs.name: Security engineering
subs.definition: Protects systems and data: application security, cloud security and detection.

taxonomy.name: Fire and EMS
taxonomy.definition: Career fire suppression, paramedic and ambulance work, prevention and emergency management. Public agencies, tested lists and shift schedules.

subs.name: Firefighter
subs.definition: Suppression, rescue and wildland crew work on an engine, truck or hand crew.

subs.name: Firefighter paramedic
subs.definition: A firefighter who also runs advanced life support on scene and in transport.

subs.name: Paramedic and EMT
subs.definition: Delivers prehospital care, plus EMS training, quality and education roles.

subs.name: Fire prevention
subs.definition: Inspects buildings, reviews plans and enforces fire code.

subs.name: Emergency management
subs.definition: Plans and runs disaster response, emergency operations centers and grants.

subs.name: Ocean lifeguard and rescue
subs.definition: Watches and rescues swimmers and boaters from the beach and the water.

taxonomy.name: Public safety tech
taxonomy.definition: Software and hardware sold to police, fire and 911 agencies. Domain knowledge from the fire service is the edge here, not just code.

subs.name: 911 and dispatch
subs.definition: Call taking, computer aided dispatch and records software for dispatch centers.

subs.name: Law enforcement tech
subs.definition: Reports, evidence and investigation software for police and sheriffs.

subs.name: Fire and EMS tech
subs.definition: Patient care reporting, fire records and hospital notification software.

subs.name: Alerting and sensors
subs.definition: Mass notification, wildfire detection and situational awareness platforms.

subs.name: Drones and field robotics
subs.definition: Unmanned aircraft, counter-drone systems and robots flown for first responders.

subs.name: Public safety platforms
subs.definition: Builds and runs the dispatch, records and alerting software itself.

taxonomy.name: Health and medtech
taxonomy.definition: Devices, sales and clinical support inside hospitals and clinics. Close to the clinical work he already knows.

subs.name: Medical device sales
subs.definition: Sells capital equipment, implants and devices to hospitals and clinics.

subs.name: Clinical specialist
subs.definition: Covers cases in the room and trains surgeons and staff on the device.

subs.name: Clinical engineering
subs.definition: Installs, maintains and validates medical equipment inside a hospital.

subs.name: Health data
subs.definition: Clinical data, informatics, electronic records and population health work.

taxonomy.name: Real estate
taxonomy.definition: Property work as an investor or an employee: brokerage, acquisitions, analysis and management. Local inventory sits in South OC and near the coast.

subs.name: Commercial brokerage
subs.definition: Leasing and investment sales for commercial property.

subs.name: Acquisitions
subs.definition: Finds, underwrites and closes property purchases.

subs.name: Asset and property management
subs.definition: Runs buildings, tenants, budgets and maintenance after the purchase.

subs.name: Real estate analysis
subs.definition: Models deals, markets and portfolios so someone can decide.

subs.name: Development and construction
subs.definition: Entitlements, design and building projects from dirt to keys.

taxonomy.name: Finance and markets
taxonomy.definition: Trading, advising, deal work and fintech for people who already trade their own book.

subs.name: Trading
subs.definition: Executes orders and manages position and market risk.

subs.name: Wealth management
subs.definition: Advises clients on portfolios, planning and retirement.

subs.name: Investment banking and deals
subs.definition: Raises capital, runs mergers and closes transactions.

subs.name: Fintech and payments
subs.definition: Builds and runs payments, lending, brokerage and treasury products.

subs.name: Research and analytics
subs.definition: Studies companies, sectors and portfolios and writes it up.

taxonomy.name: Hockey and sports
taxonomy.definition: Team, league and arena work. He played at a high level and still follows the game.

subs.name: Hockey operations
subs.definition: Runs rosters, scouting, video and team logistics for a club.

subs.name: Sports analytics
subs.definition: Models player and team performance in code for a team or league.

subs.name: Team business
subs.definition: Ticket sales, partnerships and marketing for a club.

subs.name: Venue and events
subs.definition: Runs the arena, events and game day operations.

subs.name: Coaching and development
subs.definition: Coaches players, runs youth hockey or leads development programs.

taxonomy.name: Surf and outdoor
taxonomy.definition: Brands, gear and coastal work. He surfs Salt Creek, Strands, Doheny and Trestles, so this is a lifestyle match, not just a pay match.

subs.name: Surf industry
subs.definition: Brands, boards, wetsuits and shops that sell surf gear.

subs.name: Outdoor brand
subs.definition: Product, sales and marketing for outdoor gear and apparel makers.

subs.name: Marine and harbor
subs.definition: Boats, marinas, harbor and coastal services work.

subs.name: Outdoor education
subs.definition: Guides, instructors and camp programs that teach people to be outside.

taxonomy.name: Founder track
taxonomy.definition: Early hires and company building. He already runs Kodros, The Fire Dev and Protocol Guide, so these are peer moves rather than beginner jobs.

subs.name: Founding engineer
subs.definition: Early engineer who owns product end to end with founders.

subs.name: Founding sales and marketing
subs.definition: First sales, partnerships or marketing hire at a young company.

subs.name: Generalist operations
subs.definition: Runs finance, people, systems and operations for a small company.

subs.name: Product and design lead
subs.definition: Owns what gets built and how it looks as the first product hire.
